1.en: Has there — there has indeed — come to you the tiding of the Enveloper? the Resurrection so called because it ‘envelops’ creatures with its terrors.
1.ar: ﴿هَلْ﴾ قَدْ ﴿أتاك حَدِيث الغاشِيَة﴾ القِيامَة لِأَنَّها تَغْشى الخَلائِق بِأَهْوالِها

2.en: Some faces on that day — they faces are used to represent the individuals in both instances — will be humbled abject
2.ar: ﴿وُجُوه يَوْمئِذٍ﴾ عَبَّرَ بِها عَنْ الذَّوات فِي المَوْضِعَيْنِ ﴿خاشِعَة﴾ ذَلِيلَة

3.en: toiling weary tired and exhausted from the chains and fetters
3.ar: ﴿عامِلَة ناصِبَة﴾ ذات نَصَب وتَعَب بِالسَّلاسِلِ والأَغْلال

4.en: roasting read taslā or tuslā in a scorching fire

5.en: made to drink from a boiling spring one of extremely hot temperatures.

6.en: They will have no food except cactus darī‘ — a type of thorn plant which no animal grazes on because of its vileness —
6.ar: ﴿لَيْسَ لَهُمْ طَعام إلّا مِن ضَرِيع﴾ هُوَ نَوْع مِن الشَّوْك لا تَرْعاهُ دابَّة لِخُبْثِهِ

7.en: neither nourishing nor availing against hunger.

8.en: Other faces on that day will be delicate fair

9.en: pleased by their efforts in the life of the world expended in obedience pleased in the Hereafter upon seeing the reward thereof;
9.ar: ﴿لِسَعْيِها﴾ فِي الدُّنْيا بِالطّاعَةِ ﴿راضِيَة﴾ فِي الآخِرَة لَمّا رَأَتْ ثَوابه

10.en: in a lofty Garden lofty in a physical as well as an abstract sense

11.en: in which they will not hear read lā yusma‘u ‘will not be heard’ or lā tasma‘u ‘they will not hear’ any vanity any inane soul speaking drivel;
11.ar: ﴿لا تَسْمَع﴾ بِالياءِ والتّاء ﴿فِيها لاغِيَة﴾ أيْ نَفْس ذات لَغْو: هَذَيان مِن الكَلام

12.en: therein is a running spring of water meaning ‘springs’;

13.en: therein are lofty couches lofty in terms of their essence their size and physical location

14.en: and goblets vessels without handles set around the edges of the springs prepared for them to drink with
14.ar: ﴿وأَكْواب﴾ أقْداح لا عُرا لَها ﴿مَوْضُوعَة﴾ عَلى حافّات العُيُون مُعَدَّة لِشُرْبِهِمْ

15.en: and cushions arrayed one next to the other against which they may lean
15.ar: ﴿ونَمارِق﴾ وسائِد ﴿مَصْفُوفَة﴾ بَعْضها بِجَنْبِ بَعْض يُسْتَنَد إلَيْها

16.en: and carpets rugs of velvet-hair spread out.

17.en: Will they the Meccan disbelievers not consider by way of reflection the camels how they are created?
17.ar: ﴿أفَلا يَنْظُرُونَ﴾ أيْ كُفّار مَكَّة نَظَر اِعْتِبار ﴿إلى الإبِل كَيْف خُلِقَتْ﴾

18.en: And the heaven how it was raised?

19.en: And the mountains how they were set?

20.en: And the earth how it was laid out flat? and thus infer from this the power of God exalted be He and His Oneness? The commencing with the mention of camels is because they are closer in contact with it the earth than any other animal. As for His words sutihat ‘laid out flat’ this on a literal reading suggests that the earth is flat which is the opinion of most of the scholars of the revealed Law and not a sphere as astronomers ahl al-hay’a have it even if this latter does not contradict any of the pillars of the Law.
20.ar: ﴿وإلى الأَرْض كَيْف سُطِحَتْ﴾ أيْ بُسِطَتْ، فَيَسْتَدِلُّونَ بِها عَلى قُدْرَة اللَّه تَعالى ووَحْدانِيّته، وصُدِّرَتْ بِالإبِلِ لِأَنَّهُمْ أشَدّ مُلابَسَة لَها مِن غَيْرها، وقَوْله: " سُطِحَتْ " ظاهِر فِي أنَّ الأَرْض سَطْح، وعَلَيْهِ عُلَماء الشَّرْع، لا كُرَة كَما قالَهُ أهْل الهَيْئَة وإنْ لَمْ يَنْقُض رُكْنًا مِن أرْكان الشَّرْع

21.en: So remind them of God’s graces and the proofs affirming His Oneness. For you are only an admonisher;
21.ar: ﴿فَذَكِّرْ﴾ هُمْ نِعَم اللَّه ودَلائِل تَوْحِيده " إنَّما أنْتَ مُذَكِّر "

22.en: you are not a taskmaster over them a variant reading for musaytir has musaytir that is to say not one who has been given authority over them — this was revealed before the command to struggle against the disbelievers.
22.ar: ﴿لَسْت عَلَيْهِمْ بِمُصَيْطِر﴾ وفِي قِراءَة بِالسِّينِ بَدَل الصّاد، أيْ بِمُسَلَّطٍ وهَذا قَبْل الأَمْر بِالجِهادِ

23.en: But he who turns away he who rejects faith and disbelieves in the Qur’ān
23.ar: ﴿إلّا﴾ لَكِنْ ﴿مَن تَوَلّى﴾ أعْرَضَ عَنْ الإيمان ﴿وكَفَرَ﴾ بِالقُرْآنِ

24.en: God will chastise him with the greater chastisement the chastisement of the Hereafter the lesser chastisement being that of this world that of being killed or taken captive.
24.ar: ﴿فَيُعَذِّبهُ اللَّه العَذاب الأَكْبَر﴾ عَذاب الآخِرَة والأَصْغَر عَذاب الدُّنْيا بِالقَتْلِ والأَسْر

25.en: Truly to Us will be their return their coming back after death

26.en: then truly with Us will lie their reckoning their requital which We will never abandon.
26.ar: ﴿ثُمَّ إنَّ عَلَيْنا حِسابهمْ﴾ جَزاءَهُمْ لا نَتْرُكهُ أبَدًا.
